C++26 Uncovered - Everything You Need to Know About the New Standard - Inbal Levi - ACCU 2026
---

C++26 is here, bringing one of the most feature-rich standards in the history of the language. This talk will uncover everything you need to know about the new standard from within—spanning core language improvements, powerful compile-time capabilities, safer programming models, and major library additions. We’ll explore features such as compile-time reflection, design-by-contract, saturating arithmetic, SIMD enhancements, BLAS-style linear algebra, async execution frameworks, and new debugging tools. Along the way, we’ll examine not just what these features are, but why they were added, how they fit into the evolving design of modern C++, and the real-world problems they solve.
